objective: Decide whether current source and PR delivery evidence justify a structural refactor.

trigger.observation: The requested audit considered the large calendar gateway, iCalendar codec, and recurrence projector alongside current PR delivery state. Exact main source and current PR checks were inspected.

includes: Assess observed architectural friction and current repair trigger.
excludes: Broad cleanup based on file size
constraints: Preserve existing authorization, CalDAV, recurrence, and serialization contracts.

options.summary: Keep cohesive modules intact; repair the concrete PR #164 check failure separately.
tradeoffs: Module size remains, but no unsupported churn is introduced.

options.summary: Extract the gated room-target authorization helper from CalendarGatewayController.
tradeoffs: Adds a seam before repeated controller friction has been demonstrated.

options.summary: Split controller, codec, or projector by internal responsibilities now.
tradeoffs: Broad behavior-sensitive diff with no evidenced delivery benefit.

decision.rationale: The inspected modules have cohesive responsibilities and behavior-specific test coverage. PR #164 failed on its prior merge ref before the room contract, but latest main has advanced; current validation requires synchronization and rerun, not an architectural refactor.

data: iCalendar source resources and unknown-property preservation
unknowns: PR #164 room contract behavior until CI reaches it

preservation_gates.criterion: No production behavior is changed by this assessment.

validation.criterion: Exact main SHA, current PR heads, issue states, and PR #164 failed job steps are captured.
validation.command: GitHub API/CLI read-only queries and exact-SHA source inspection

deferrals.reason: PR #164 is the first observed room-target change and its integration tests have not reached the room behavior.
deferrals.upgrade_seam: Reassess if a second room-target route duplicates policy or room authorization edits become broad/repeated.

deferrals.item: Split iCalendar codec by recurrence/alarm handling.
deferrals.reason: No repeated change failure or testability friction was demonstrated; the shared round-trip boundary is valuable.
deferrals.upgrade_seam: Reassess if recurrence/alarm changes repeatedly destabilize unrelated basic field round trips.

next_action: Refresh PR #164 to main 8bf300f, diagnose its first failing server test/module-load probe with sanitized output, and rerun room access and cross-room assertions; revalidate the behind PRs against current main.
